commands.claude_code:
claude mcp add --scope user --transport http giljo_hq https://app.giljo.ai/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer tk_test_api_key_0000000000000000"
commands.claude_code_oauth: claude mcp add --transport http giljo_hq https://app.giljo.ai/mcp --scope user
commands.claude_desktop_oauth: Add the GiljoAI connector in Claude Desktop or claude.ai settings; it runs OAuth in the browser.
commands.codex_cli: codex mcp add giljo_hq --url https://app.giljo.ai/mcp --bearer-token-env-var GILJO_API_KEY
commands.opencode: opencode mcp add giljo_hq --url https://app.giljo.ai/mcp --header "Authorization=Bearer tk_test_api_key_0000000000000000"
commands.opencode_oauth:
opencode mcp add giljo_hq --url https://app.giljo.ai/mcp
opencode mcp auth giljo_hq
